redactions: Personal profile path returned by the no-HOME path-expansion probe
Identity and configuration values; only argv, keys, scopes, origins and output hashes are retained
Raw stdout/stderr stream contents, environment contents and child process identifiers
preserved: All measured durations and original median/range n=3 summaries

projection.originalStreams: Retained with the external original evidence; stream contents are intentionally not copied into this public projection.
projection.runnerFingerprintScope: Observed while projecting the completed result. The experiment output does not attest runner-source fingerprints before/after execution.
projection.qualification: FAIL is preserved: both executable paths expanded the synthetic tilde probe outside the fixture after HOME was removed. Equal measured outputs and preserved repository snapshots do not repair this isolation failure. This run is not an approved basis for adopting a backend.

methodology.execution: sequential; alternating AB/BA order by sample and query
methodology.warmup: one unmeasured version query per executable and mode after fixture setup
methodology.cache: No OS cache eviction; first measured process is not an OS cold-cache claim.
methodology.scope: Native process startup microbenchmark; no Core validation latency is measured.
methodology.environment: Both paths receive the same allowlisted fixture environment per mode. The optional no-home mode removes HOME and demonstrably fails the fixture-confined tilde-expansion check on both paths.
methodology.subprocesses: Every direct spawn attempt is recorded. Descendants created internally by Git/wrapper are not observed; no physical-process total is inferred.
methodology.statistics: Median and observed range only; no p95 or significance claim with n=3.
methodology.adoption: This experiment never selects a new product executable or changes PATH, Git installation or global configuration.

comparisons.qualification: Three paired samples are exploratory; no statistical significance or universal causal claim.
